# This site republishes Konami's event coverage for one person's use. It is
# public because GitHub Pages is, not because it is meant to be found.
#
# Search engines honour this; it is a request, not a control. Anyone with the
# URL can still read the site, and a crawler that ignores robots.txt still will.
# The noindex meta tag in index.html says the same thing to the ones that check
# the page rather than this file.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /
